title: Differential Gene Expression: Top 20 | CFDE Knowledge Center
bodyHtml:
Click the Research Method tab to find full details about datasets, tissues, phenotypes, and analysis methods and to see potential next steps after obtaining DE results.

The upper plot and upper table display the top differentially expressed genes for each combination of tissue, disease condition (phenotype), and dataset.

The lower plot and lower table show the phenotypic associations of gene sets created from the DE analysis displayed above. Gene sets were created with the top differentially expressed genes (up to 250 genes) per source.

Top differentially expressed genes per phenotype
